notes: Starter question set for the Aurora Research Method (ARM) benchmark. Mix of Regime B (well-documented, canonical sources exist) and Regime A (scattered / emerging / contested), plus hybrids. Regime tag is the EXPECTED regime, not ground truth — part of what the benchmark measures is whether ARM helps more in Regime A.

questions.prompt: What are the documented breaking changes and new features introduced in React 19 compared to React 18? Cover the migration-relevant items.
Summarize the OWASP Top 10 (2021 edition) web application security risks, with the official description of each category.
What are the main technical differences between HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, including the transport layer and head-of-line blocking behaviour?
How did Python packaging move from the classic setuptools/setup.py model to the PEP 517/518 build-system model? Cover the standards and what changed for package authors.

Map the current landscape of production deployments of LLM agents in enterprise software engineering (2024-2026). Distinguish what is actually shipped to users from demos, prototypes, and vendor claims.
What are the documented real-world failure modes, scaling limits, and incidents of vector database systems run at scale (2023-2026)?
Map the regulatory landscape for stablecoin issuance across the EU (MiCA), the US, and the UK as of 2025-2026, including what is settled versus still in flux per jurisdiction.
What are the documented patterns, tooling, and tradeoffs for running fine-tuned small language models on-device (edge / mobile) in production (2024-2026)?

What are the current best practices and documented tradeoffs for using PostgreSQL with pgvector as the vector store in a production RAG system (2024-2026)? (Postgres basics are well documented; pgvector-at-scale-for-RAG is less so.)

What are the current best practices for adopting WebAuthn / passkeys in consumer web apps, and what real-world adoption friction and edge cases are documented (2024-2026)? (The spec is canonical; deployment friction is scattered.)
